basis: OMI average residential quotation (EUR/m2): mean of the mid-points of the minimum/maximum sale ranges of the residential typologies quoted in the comune's OMI zones; an official valuation quotation, not a transaction price
name: Como
notes: Como: Agenzia delle Entrate OMI, Statistiche regionali 2017-2026 (years 2016-2025). City line: the average quotation of the capital in the regional table 'Quotazione media e variazione annua per capoluogo e resto provincia': the unweighted mean, over the comune's OMI zones and residential typologies, of the mid-points of the sale ranges (the comparison is the rest of the province). Annual, stamped 1 July; the build interpolates the quarters between years. Each step is the ratio of the published levels, or the published year-on-year change where the two disagree (the publisher reconstructs the previous year after a zone redefinition); the published change is used out of 2023; the first year (2015) is the next level divided by its published change. 14 OMI zones with at least two years (published levels; a level is dropped where the next year's published change contradicts it by more than 3 points). Quotations are valuation ranges from deeds, offers and surveys, not transaction prices and not quality-adjusted; zones were redrawn in 2024.
